description: The Products category registry and the appliance product groups: EPREL household washing machines and refrigerating appliances and the overlapping Open Icecat categories, with category-scoped attributes, units, modes and label schemes, category-aware matching and comparison, and page-addressable citations of provider-linked datasheets and product information sheets. Records stay in the products.core store; nothing is ranked or recommended.

semantic_constraints.registry: attributes, canonical and accepted units, modes and label schemes are defined per category; a native field no mapping names stays a source field
semantic_constraints.units: exact decimal conversions registered in the quantitative store; units are category-aware and per-cycle or per-annum energy never converts into plain energy
semantic_constraints.matching: candidates only inside one category, from the category's identifier rule and corroborating attributes; never merged without review
semantic_constraints.comparison: rows from the registry; a row compares only on a shared attribute, mode, unit and label scheme; mixed categories are refused
semantic_constraints.documents: provider-linked documents only, cited by link, content hash and page
